text:
Let nothing disturb you.
Let nothing frighten you.
All things are passing away:
God never changes.
Patience obtains everything.
Whoever has God lacks nothing;
God alone suffices.
latin:
Nihil te turbet,
nihil te terreat,
omnia transeunt:
Deus non mutatur.
Patientia
omnia obtinet;
qui Deum habet
nihil ei deest:
solus Deus sufficit.
